description: The inverse of the canonical bijection \(A/{\sim_f}\to f(A)\) sends \(y\in f(A)\) to the class whose underlying set is \(f^{-1}(\{y\})\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.quotient_image_inverse_fiber.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) (y : ↑(Set.range f)) :
  ↑((Setoid.ker f).quotientEquivClasses ((Setoid.quotientKerEquivRange f).symm y)) = f ⁻¹' {↑y}
